note: Refused submissions only. A submission that was INGESTED is in /v1/determinations, and one that never reached this service is in neither. These are NOT in /v1/refusals: that route serves payment refusals, which carry a spend, and an ingestion refusal stopped no payment so it has no figure to contribute.
readFrom: this process. Refusals it recorded and refusals it replayed at startup; a refusal written to the store file by another process after this one started is not here.
